item.title: Jobs report: Hiring isn’t dead, it’s just getting more deliberate
item.description: Employers are prioritizing fewer, more critical hires rather than broad hiring plans, and expects activity to pick up as budgets unlock through the first quarter. The post Jobs report: Hiring isn’t dead, it’s just getting more deliberate appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: The $2 trillion blind spot in modern rewards

item.title: The murky waters of healthcare cost transparency: What plan sponsors can control
item.description: The truth is, even the most engaged plan sponsors can only exert so much control over healthcare costs. What they can control is how they evaluate and monitor their vendors. The post The murky waters of healthcare cost transparency: What plan sponsors can control appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Think RTO is harmless? Top talent disagrees
item.description: High-potential employees are among those most likely to leave under a strict return-to-office policy. This expert shares how HR can use that reality to drive policies focused on long-range talent goals. The post Think RTO is harmless? Top talent disagrees appeared first on HR Executive.
